inputs.commit_message: docs: verify no P2P references remain
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
pattern='p2p|peer[- ]to[- ]peer|direct[ -]?agent|direct-p2p|local-agent:direct|local-agent-direct|host[ -]?discovery|ASOL_DEVICE_DISCOVERY|GOVA_DIRECT_|48732|x25519|webrtc|ice/stun|stun/udp'
hits="$(git grep -I -n -i -E "$pattern" -- docs || true)"
if [ -n "$hits" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$hits"
  echo 'DOCS_P2P_REFERENCE_SCAN=dirty' >&2
  exit 42
fi
echo 'DOCS_P2P_REFERENCE_SCAN=clean'
